studio.introP1: QuackBytes is a young, independent studio in Kayseri for the parts of your business that don’t fit neatly into someone else’s product.
studio.introP2: We handle brand identity, custom software, integrations, web products and security. The common thread? A specific problem, properly understood, and something useful on the other side.
studio.handwritten: A little wordplay. A whole philosophy.
studio.storyLarge:
Small enough to stay focused.
Custom enough to actually fit.
Built well enough to grow.
studio.storyP1: “Quick Bites” is our way of thinking about scope. Find the part that matters. Give it the attention it deserves. Build something that earns its place in your working day.
studio.storyP2: A bite might be a single logo or a complete platform. Its size comes from the problem, not a package.
studio.principle1P: We ask how things work today, where they get stuck and what a better day would look like. The technology comes after the understanding.
studio.principle2P: We agree on a clear scope and make the trade-offs visible. The goal is useful work with a clear job, built around the people who will use it.
studio.principle3P: Readable code, sensible documentation and a thoughtful handover. We discuss maintenance and the next steps early, so you know what you’re taking on.
studio.processLead:
A close collaboration.
No disappearing act.

steps.label: 01 / UNDERSTAND
steps.title: Show us the snag.
steps.text: A messy workflow, an awkward workaround, an idea you can’t quite put down. We start there.

steps.label: 02 / SHAPE
steps.title: Find the right bite.
steps.text: We define the smallest useful solution, agree on scope and talk through the time and investment.

steps.label: 03 / BUILD
steps.title: Make it tangible.
steps.text: Working design and software, shared early. Your feedback helps it fit the way you actually work.

steps.label: 04 / HAND OVER
steps.title: Put it to work.
steps.text: Test the real scenarios, get it into use and leave you with a clear path to what’s next.
